subject: general
question: The term ‘Parliament’ refers to the ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**National legislature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 The Constitution's Part V (Articles 79–122) deals with the Parliament's organisation, composition, duration, officers, processes, privileges, and powers.

__
 
• The Indian Constitution's framer chose the British model for Parliament above the American model.
 
• The Parliament is the legislative organ of a Union government and the Parliament of India is the top legislative body of the country.
 
• **The Parliament is the National legislature, whereas the state legislature is known as the State Legislature.**
 
• it holds a preeminent and prominent place in the Indian democratic political system because of the adoption of the parliamentary form of government. 
 
• Parliamentary Organs: 
 
 
• President of India
 
• Rajya Sabha (Upper House)
 
• Lok Sabha (Lower House)
 
 
 
• The Indian Parliament is bicameral, the Rajya Sabha and the Lok Sabha. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is the Upper House that represents the Indian Union's states and union territories.
 
• It is the Lower House that represents all of India's citizens.
 
• The President of India is not a member of either House and does not attend any of the Parliament's proceedings.
